lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular spots are arranged in distinct vertical columns posterior to the fifth gill slit. The first visible column contains five spots, while subsequent posterior columns exhibit 3 to 4 spots, maintaining a regular grid-like spatial distribution.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the high-luminance blobs, forming a matrix of nodes across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three primary horizontal ridges are visible, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient transition (specular highlight on the dorsal edge, shadow on the ventral edge) extending from the gill region toward the caudal peduncle.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low-contrast distribution of at least three high-luminance blobs localized within the anterior and mid-sections of the first dorsal fin silhouette.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct T-shaped high-luminance external object (research tag) is anchored to the upper trailing edge of the first dorsal fin, accompanied by a thin trailing filament.
other_distinctive_markers: Multiple high-luminance, fusiform-shaped commensal fish are positioned ventrally to the shark's midline and posterior to the pectoral fin.
